overview.text: Maricela Romero Frymark is the chair of the City of Irwindale Planning Commission. At a 2023 meeting, she encouraged the commission to compromise with a youth organization. She stated that the city lacked a strong sports program and the long-term value of sports outweighed any potential damage to park turf.
